summary: Flathead County, MT ground site on the Flathead NF, 10 miles east of Bigfork: an L-4 cab listed for 1931, destroyed in 1953. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1953 according to firelookout.com; the state list files it under Ground and marks it gone.

events.note: L-4 cab listed for 1931, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: state list files the site under Ground and marks it gone
evidence.quote: Tom Tom Mountain Flathead 48.05743 -113.86360 Ground Gone

sources.title: Tom Tom Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: one firelookout.com page and the state list. Two searches, a Forest Lookouts check (the Tom Tom page there returned 404) and a grep of the Flathead history and Daily Interlake articles found no further mention, and no staffing, fire or NRHP source. Nothing describes what remains on the mountain. Story runs under 120 words because the evidence is thin; the editor may prefer to hold it or accept it as a short stub.
